title: Title 18 USC – Crimes and Criminal Procedure

versions.text:
Title 18 – Crimes and Criminal Procedure.
Part I – Crimes. Chapter 1: General provisions. Chapter 2: Aircraft and motor vehicles. Chapter 7: Assault. Chapter 11: Bribery, graft. Chapter 25: Counterfeiting and forgery. Chapter 31: Embezzlement. Chapter 33: Emblems, insignia. Chapter 41: Extortion and threats. Chapter 47: Fraud and false statements (wire fraud §1343, mail fraud §1341, bank fraud §1344). Chapter 73: Obstruction of justice. Chapter 95: Racketeering (RICO §1961-1968). Chapter 96: Racketeer Influenced and Corrupt Organizations. Chapter 109A: Sexual abuse. Chapter 110: Sexual exploitation of children. Chapter 113B: Terrorism.
Part II – Criminal Procedure. Chapter 201: Arrests and commitments. Chapter 207: Release and detention. Chapter 213: Limitations. Chapter 227: Sentences. Chapter 229: Postsentence administration.
